mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_usage_daily (id, tenant_code, stat_date, sessions, messages, ai_calls, seats, storage_gb, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantCode}, #{statDate}, #{sessions}, #{messages}, #{aiCalls}, #{seats}, #{storageGb}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (tenant_code, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET sessions = billing_usage_daily.sessions + EXCLUDED.sessions, messages = billing_usage_daily.messages + EXCLUDED.messages, ai_calls = billing_usage_daily.ai_calls + EXCLUDED.ai_calls, seats = GREATEST(billing_usage_daily.seats, EXCLUDED.seats), storage_gb = GREATEST(billing_usage_daily.storage_gb, EXCLUDED.storage_gb), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT u.seats FROM billing_usage_daily u WHERE u.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} ORDER BY u.stat_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS statements, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 2), 0) AS settled_amount, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 1), 0) AS pending_amount, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 3) AS overdue_count FROM billing_statement s WHERE s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.cycle_key = #{cycleKey}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS paid_amount FROM billing_order o WHERE o.is_deleted = FALSE AND o.status = 2 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND to_char(o.pay_time, 'YYYY-MM') = #{cycleKey}
SELECT * FROM billing_order o WHERE ORDER BY o.pay_time DESC NULLS LAST, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM billing_order o WHERE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM billing_order o WHERE

SELECT COALESCE(s.plan_name, '未开通套餐') AS name, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM billing_statement s WHERE s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.cycle_key = #{cycleKey} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT * FROM plan p WHERE p.is_deleted = FALSE AND p.is_enabled = TRUE ORDER BY p.price_monthly
